_notes.f15_webroot_js: Files at the webroot that are yours by name, e.g. a remediation service worker you placed to unregister a malicious one. Any OTHER .js at the webroot is HIGH.
_notes.network_cidrs: Deliberately empty: 'not configured' until a human fills it in from the settings page. A list with only an office range in it makes every home login HIGH.
_notes.f16_self_heal: Plugins that legitimately unpack archives into the plugin directory or write to uploads on activation: NinjaScanner (compares plugins against fresh copies), LearnDash's design wizard, Wordfence, Gravity Forms. Extend by path when you meet another.
_notes.f9_loader_structure: Exact file paths only for vendor bundles that carry the decode-and-run shape. F10 (the decoder STRUCTURE) has no allow-list and still guards every one of these, and S6 catches any change after the baseline.

_note: Path fragments are matched against the path relative to wp-content, forward slashes, case-insensitive.
